tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The dark value is the logo's own navy-slate ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, the active tab; sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code cells, notebook outputs, inputs; anything 'inside' a panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, table rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, quiz options). ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, repo paths, placeholders. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Synapse teal. Primary action fill, active tab indicator, focus ring, links, the 'running' state. As text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: selected quiz option, concept chips, active nav item.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label). Dark text in the dark theme because accent is bright there.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The logo's brightest node colour. ONLY for glow halos (shadow-glow) and the live-node dot in illustrations — never text, never a fill larger than 16px.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: The logo's deeper teal strands. Diagram edges, secondary chart series, the progress-ring track fill. ≥5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Tests passed, correct answer, lesson complete. As text on the surfaces and success-soft. Always paired with a ✓ icon or the word 'Passed'.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text: passed test row, correct quiz option.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale lesson ('code changed since this lesson'), slow cell (>30 s). As text on the surfaces and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text: stale banner, slow-cell notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed test, wrong answer, cell error, destructive action. As text on the surfaces and danger-soft. Always paired with a ✕ icon or the word 'Failed'.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text: failing test row, traceback output, wrong quiz option.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax: keywords (def, return, import). On surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Syntax: strings and docstrings. On surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Syntax: numbers and constants. On surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Syntax: function and class names — the one place glow appears as text, because names are what a lesson is about. On surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Syntax: comments. On surface-sunken (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in lesson prose — an alias of accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every interactive element — an alias of accent; ≥4.7:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hub landing and empty states only. One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings inside Explain; decision titles.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above titles and on tab groups — echoes the wordmark's wide caps. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: One or two sentences on what was built and why.
styles.usage: Lesson summary / lede under the h1.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The voxel key is computed with integer floor division so negative coordinates land in the right cell.
styles.usage: Lesson prose (Explain, Decisions, quiz explanations). Max line length = size reading-width.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: UI copy: cards, tables, test results, hints.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Notebook cells, exercise editor, code blocks.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code, source_ref anchors, file paths, cell outputs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards, cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between notebook cells.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a lesson page, between Explain sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing/empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code cells, quiz options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, the node dot, avatars, progress rings.

shadow.note: Calm technical: surfaces are separated by tone and hairlines, not shadows. Glow is reserved for state.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the dragged card. Not on resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The one glow: a running cell, a just-passed exercise, the hovered primary button. Never on more than one element at a time.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px gap + 2px accent) on every interactive element.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: Max width of lesson prose (Explain, Decisions, Quiz).

tokens.name: notebook-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the notebook and Rebuild editor column.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Library grid and header max width.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Lesson outline / data-slot panel.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs (28px for size sm).
